title: ononis alopecuroides var. baetica
intro: Ononis alopecuroides var. baetica, commonly known as Spanish restharrow, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Spanish restharrow include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
